name: wmkf_requestdocument-pre-site-draft
_comment: Additive Pre-Site Visit draft fields on the existing governed request-document registry. Apply only after scripts/preflight-pre-site-draft-schema.mjs reports no divergent metadata. Runtime readers/writers must not select these fields until the target environment has this wave.
